# host_package_dnf (Resource)

Manages a single DNF package and keeps its DNF install reason marked as `User`.

With the default `ignore_version = true`, the resource manages package presence
and install reason without querying enabled repositories for candidate or
upgrade versions. Set it to false only when Terraform should plan upgrades to
the latest available version.

`install_reason` is both desired and observed state. The only configurable
policy is `user`. If an external package operation changes the reason, refresh
records DNF's normalized reason and the next apply marks the package as
user-installed again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "host_package_dnf" "git" {
  name    = "git"
  version = "latest"
}

resource "host_package_dnf" "neovim" {
  name           = "neovim"
  install_reason = "user"
}

resource "host_package_dnf" "ripgrep" {
  name = "ripgrep"
}
```

## Import

Import an installed package by name:

```shell
terraform import host_package_dnf.git git
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) DNF package name.

### Optional

- `autoremove` (Boolean) Allow DNF to remove dependencies that become unused when this package is removed.
- `ignore_version` (Boolean) Ignore available version updates. When true, the resource manages package presence and DNF install reason without planning upgrades for new candidate versions.
- `install_reason` (String) Desired and observed DNF install reason. The only supported desired value is `user`; refresh records the normalized DNF reason after external drift so the next apply restores `user`.
- `version` (String) Package version policy. Only `latest` is currently supported. Used for upgrade planning only when `ignore_version` is false.

### Read-Only

- `candidate_version` (String) DNF EVR of the latest package candidate from enabled repositories. Null when `ignore_version` is true.
- `id` (String) Resource identifier, equal to `name`.
- `installed_version` (String) DNF EVR of the installed package.
